topic: you are not your bank balance
lines: Maybe you're behind on things. Maybe you're *embarrassed.*
Maybe you avoid friends because you can't afford to go *out.*
#And slowly, you start to feel like *less.*
It doesn't show how hard you're *fighting.*
It doesn't show the people you *carry.*
Or the *dreams* you still hold onto.
#Some of the richest people are deeply *unhappy.*
And some people with almost nothing have more *peace* than anyone you know.
#Yes, work on your money. Build it. *Protect* it.
But never let it tell you who you *are.*
Your worth was never *up* for debate.
end: Send this to someone who's struggling with money.
